🔗
template<class M, class N>
  constexpr common_type_t<M, N> lcm(M m, N n);
1
#
Mandates: M and N both are integer types other than
cv bool.
2
#
Preconditions: |m| and |n|
are representable as a value of common_type_t<M, N>.
 The least common multiple of |m| and |n|
is representable as a value of type common_type_t<M, N>.
3
#
Returns: Zero when either m or n is zero.
 Otherwise, returns the least common multiple of |m| and |n|.
4
#
Throws: Nothing.
